name: Letter
long_description: The Letter Company issues autonomous pull requests to scale websites, agent experiences, and so much more. Today, we solve modern issues like agentic conviction, inbound conversion, SEO, GEO, etc. However, we believe as agents become more truth-seeking, spammy marketing strategies will fall apart in favor of benchmark and evidence-based messaging. These are engineering problems that only a purpose-built coding agent can solve.
one_liner: The world's first coding agent, IDE & infra for growth engineering.
